name: Mauritius
shortSummary: Mauritius is arguably India's closest partner in Africa, with roughly two-thirds of its population of Indian origin, deep maritime-security cooperation, and historically one of the largest sources of foreign investment into India.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Agalega Island facilities support joint Indian Ocean surveillance.
Roughly two-thirds of the Mauritian population is of Indian origin, and Mauritius has historically been a major investment conduit into India.

recentDevelopments.title: Agalega infrastructure and CECPA implementation continue
recentDevelopments.description: Maritime infrastructure cooperation on Agalega Island and implementation of the 2021 trade agreement continued deepening.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Mauritius remains India's closest African partner by nearly every measure, from demographics to strategic trust.

historicalEvents.title: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations at Independence
historicalEvents.description: India establishes diplomatic relations with Mauritius immediately upon its independence, reflecting deep historic ties to its majority Indian-origin population.

historicalEvents.title: Agalega Island Infrastructure Agreement
historicalEvents.description: India and Mauritius agree to develop infrastructure on Agalega Island to support maritime domain awareness in the western Indian Ocean.
historicalEvents.impact: Strengthened India's Indian Ocean maritime security posture.

historicalEvents.title: Comprehensive Economic Cooperation and Partnership Agreement
historicalEvents.description: India and Mauritius sign India's first trade agreement with an African nation.

agreements.name: Comprehensive Economic Cooperation and Partnership Agreement
agreements.description: India's first trade agreement with any African nation.

defenceCooperation.description: Jointly developed airstrip and jetty supporting Indian Ocean maritime surveillance.
